grading_rationale: 5 P1 findings exceeds C threshold (max_p1: 2). Spec coverage 96% (Source-scope) satisfies A, but CVE severity forces grade to D.
skip_reason: Backend (http://localhost:3001) and Frontend (http://localhost:5173) offline at audit time

escalations.title: vitest CRITICAL (protobufjs RCE) — portal/Frontend
escalations.exploit_scenario: If CI/CD processes untrusted input through the test runner, the protobufjs vulnerability in vitest's transitive chain enables Remote Code Execution on the build agent.
escalations.fix: cd portal/Frontend && npm update vitest (to v2.0.5+)

escalations.title: vitest CRITICAL (protobufjs RCE) — portal/Backend
escalations.exploit_scenario: Same protobufjs RCE chain as DEP-001 — affects portal/Backend test infrastructure.
escalations.fix: cd portal/Backend && npm update vitest (to v2.0.0+)

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (RCE) — Source/Backend
escalations.exploit_scenario: Tamper with @partial-block in a Handlebars template that receives user-supplied input → arbitrary JavaScript execution on the server. Even if templates are static today, the dependency is unsafe and must be patched before any new template usage is introduced.
escalations.fix: Run npm ls handlebars in Source/Backend to identify the parent dep. Update to handlebars@4.7.9+.

p1_findings.title: Missing GET /api/search route — 5 tests will fail
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: DependencyPicker typeahead in the frontend calls GET /api/search. The route is never registered in app.ts. All 5 test cases will fail and the feature is broken in production.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts with handler filtering non-deleted items by ?q= on title/description. Register in app.ts. Remove the warning comment once tests pass. Wire through service layer per architecture rules.

p1_findings.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node CRITICAL crash chain — portal/Backend
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Malformed HTTP request to portal/Backend crashes the Prometheus exporter process. Combined with @opentelemetry/sdk-node crash on malformed compressed messages, any client can silence the telemetry pipeline via DoS.
p1_findings.fix: cd portal/Backend && npm update @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node (to v0.79.0+) && npm update @opentelemetry/sdk-node (to v0.50.0+)

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-001 through FR-TMP-010: 0% source coverage
p2_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-NNN annotations to Source/E2E/playwright.config.ts and platform scripts (solo-session required for platform/). Alternatively create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly — 12+ call sites bypass service layer
p2_findings.recommendation: Introduce workItemService.ts and workflowService.ts. Route all store.* calls through service functions. Move inline state-mutation blocks (workflow.ts lines 119-140, 175-200, 269-290) into service layer.

p2_findings.title: spec-drift-audit.py scans Specifications/ only — misses Plans/ FRs, gives false alarms
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend spec-drift-audit.py to also scan Plans/*/requirements.md as source of canonical FRs, or populate tools/fr-aliases.json to map FR-WF-* and FR-dependency-* IDs.

p2_findings.title: Vite fs.deny bypass on Windows (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update vite to v6.4.3+ in both Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection in multipart field names/filenames
p2_findings.recommendation: Update the direct dependency that pulls in form-data (likely axios or similar). Run npm audit fix with review.

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion DoS — exponential {} expansion hangs process
p2_findings.recommendation: Update glob/npm internals. npm audit fix in Source/Backend.

p2_findings.title: js-yaml DoS via repeated merge-key aliases (quadratic CPU spike)
p2_findings.recommendation: Update js-yaml to v3.14.1+ or v4.x. Identify direct dep pulling it in.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS via multiple route parameters
p2_findings.recommendation: Update express to v4.22.3+ or latest minor in platform/orchestrator.
